changelog: **Gear recommendations stay in your level window.** The Gear tab now recommends pieces you can actually get soon: required level no more than three above you, from a dungeon or zone in range, usable by your class, and better than what you are wearing when the scorer can tell. **Path shows the quests to pick up in each zone.** Open a zone on the Path tab to see a parent/child list: the chain starter on top, follow-ups indented beneath it. **Goals groups start closed.** Trainer spells by level, and every other Goals group, begin collapsed. **Craft resets Other professions.** The Other professions section starts collapsed again when you leave the Craft tab or close the window, the same way profession detail is reset. **Guild tab is a group finder.** Your card at the top shows a circular portrait, name, level, class color, zone, and a status pill. **Demo guildmates (off by default).** To preview the Guild tab with a fake roster, turn on **Demo guildmates** in Settings or type `/codex demo on`.
